items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I heard a lot of him but I never, never...and he's out in California too...I never know.

ctx.x: He didn't come around Chicago much. Mostly St. Louis, New Orleans, St. Louis, and then New York.

Yeah, I heard a lot of him but I never, never...and he's out in California too. Yeah, working with Hines and Muxley and Darnell. Oh, no. Well, listen, what become of Eddie White was a bass...I never know. He was from Louisiana. He was with Joe Oliver when I first came around Chicago. He played bass with Joe. It was...I think it was Eddie Garland. Oh, Eddie Garland. Yeah.

Oh, yes. I saw him in California. Yeah. Had a nice interview with him. Yeah. Yeah. Looks good. Same as ever. Yeah. Eddie Garland. He's more bald than I am. Is that so? He gets around good. He's about 70 years old.
